summary: Verified the new BookAppointmentModal Slot-Suggestion Panel end-to-end. Backend past-time / double-booking / availability regression suite (11 tests, iter68) re-ran clean (10 passed, 1 env-skipped). Frontend: happy path, past-time trigger, pill click-to-fill, empty state, testid format, and no-unnecessary-tomorrow-prefetch all verified. Found 2 real bugs: (1) EDIT-mode past appointment SHOWS the amber panel (spec says it must not); (2) off-clinic-hours times with no matching slot in the grid (e.g. 21:45 when clinic closes 21:00) don't trigger the panel because pickedIsUnavailable only fires when a slot row exists OR date/time is past. Spill-over-to-tomorrow with ' · tomorrow' suffix could NOT be reproduced in the environment due to bug #2 blocking the late-time scenario — code path exists and looks correct on review.

ui_bugs.issue: EDIT mode on a PAST appointment shows the amber suggestion panel (data-testid='bk-slot-suggestion') with 'HH:MM — Time has passed'. Spec explicitly requires the panel to be HIDDEN when editing metadata on a past appointment (impacts_schedule=false path). Reproduce: click any past calendar card (e.g. 10:00-10:30 on Mon 3 Aug) → Edit modal opens → panel visible immediately.

Off-clinic-hours times that have NO matching slot in the fetched grid don't trigger the panel. Repro: set time to 21:45 on today (clinic closes 21:00, no 21:45 slot exists) → panel is NOT shown even though the slot is unbookable. Root cause: pickedIsUnavailable requires either (a) matching slot in grid marked !available, or (b) date/time strictly in the past. Third case (typed time falls outside the day's slot grid entirely) is not covered — so the promised 'when the picked slot is out of clinic hours, suggest the next 3 valid slots' UX fails for that flow. As a side-effect the tomorrow-spillover (' · tomorrow' pill suffix) could not be exercised because the natural scenario (all today slots gone) can't be reached without this trigger firing.

action_items: Fix EDIT-mode past-appointment bug: gate the panel with `!isEdit` OR require impacts_schedule semantics (skip past-time trigger when only metadata is being edited). Simplest patch: change line 851 `{pickedIsUnavailable && (` to `{pickedIsUnavailable && !isEdit && (` — matches the backend's soft-check philosophy.

Extend pickedIsUnavailable (lines 511-521) to fire when the typed time falls OUTSIDE any slot boundary on a day that DOES have a slot grid — e.g. `(!pickedSlot && slots.length > 0 && slots.every(s => s.start_at !== pickedTimeIso))` should also count as unavailable so the panel proactively surfaces next slots for off-shift picks like 21:45. This is the ONLY unfixed gap in the promised 'out of clinic hours' UX from the review request.
Optional: pass `override` param to the tomorrow prefetch axios call (line 546-552) for consistency with the same-day fetch — currently omitted.
critical_code_review_comments: Panel gating is missing an isEdit check — see action_items #1.
pickedIsUnavailable doesn't cover the 'no matching slot in grid AND time not in past' case (off-clinic-hours typed times). Small logic gap; easy fix.
The tomorrow-prefetch effect uses `nextDaySlots?.date === tomorrowISO` as its guard — good caching. Cleanup happens implicitly on modal unmount so no leak.

Container `<div data-testid='bk-suggestion-pills'>` shares the `bk-suggestion-` prefix with real pill testids `bk-suggestion-<date>-<time>`. Any tester using `[data-testid^='bk-suggestion-']` will pick up the container too. Suggest renaming container to `bk-suggestion-pill-container` OR filtering pill selectors to `bk-suggestion-2` (year prefix) as we did in our tests.

applySuggestion (line 575-578) doesn't reset `durationManuallySet` — harmless but if a user picks a suggested slot after manually overriding duration, that override survives. Probably desired, but worth confirming.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (edit-mode panel): the render conditional on line 851 (`{pickedIsUnavailable && (`) does not consider `isEdit`. The past-time computation happens against any current-time slot regardless of whether the modal is opened for a NEW booking or to EDIT an existing (past) row. Since past appointments carry a past start_at, the picked slot immediately matches a `Time has passed` reason (or falls in the date<today branch). Backend already treats metadata-only edits softly (impacts_schedule=false in schedules.py PUT flow); the frontend needs the same asymmetry. Bug 2 (off-shift no-slot): pickedIsUnavailable's second branch only considers past date/time; when the typed time doesn't intersect the day's slot grid (e.g. 21:45 for a 09:00-21:00 clinic), pickedSlot is null AND the time is NOT past (nowHHMM ~01:59, so 21:45 > now), so pickedIsUnavailable evaluates to false. Downstream: the panel never renders, and the whole tomorrow-spillover path is unreachable via that natural scenario.
